stem: Which idea is supported throughout the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Lindbergh was younger than most pilots hoping to fly from New York to Paris.

options.label: B
options.text: Airplanes with multiple engines were safest for crossing the Atlantic Ocean.

options.label: C
options.text: It took Lindbergh years to get the money he needed to build his plane.

options.label: D
options.text: Lindbergh believed a new strategy was needed to fly from New York to Paris.
